name: OpenAPI tools
note: Any REST API as a tool
summary: Turning an existing REST API described by an OpenAPI document into tools an agent can call. Each operation's path, parameters and schema become a tool name, description and input schema, either directly in the agent framework or through a generated MCP server.
how: Start from the API's OpenAPI (Swagger) document
Map each operation to a tool with a JSON Schema for its inputs
Trim or rename operations so the model sees a small, clear set
Handle auth and execute the HTTP call when the model picks a tool
Return the response, truncated if large, to the model
facts: Fast to set up, but raw endpoints are often too granular for models
goodFor: APIs that already publish an OpenAPI document
Internal services without an MCP server
watchOut: Large specs flood the context with tools
Endpoint descriptions written for humans may confuse models
Write operations need careful permission handling
